description: Ministry of Labour, Trade Union Relations - Notify the Collective Agreement entered into between Indian Bank, Indian Overseas Bank, State Bank of India and the Ceylon Bank Employees Union  (E only)
reasoning: This gazette content publishes a Collective Agreement between banks and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory provisions about employment terms, salary scales, allowances, and dispute resolution mechanisms. This constitutes a legal/regulatory matter as it involves the formal publication of a binding agreement under statutory authority, establishing regulatory frameworks for employment conditions in the banking sector.
